items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And this big fella comes here all the time. Let's see what's his name. Uh Irishman. ... [INTERVIEWEE] He plays in St. Lafonses' Arden on Sunday.

ctx.x: Let's see. Hal Stringer's playing tenor there and he's got a alto and a clarinet. It's like a BAME system playing that. That must be late years. Yes. I don't recognize the other fellas.
And this big fella comes here all the time. Let's see what's his name. Uh Irishman. Sometimes he plays in St. Lafonses' Arden.

He plays in St. Lafonses' Arden on Sunday. Right there. You know where I first heard Tom was up uh Audubon Park with uh Red Hot Bergen. Oh yeah. And that was a good band there. Oh yes. With Harry Shields on clarinet. I know.
